title.en: An Act Declaring December 15 of Each Year as Naga City Charter Day and a Special Working Public Holiday in the City of Naga in Order to Commemorate the Anniversary of the Said City
title.orig: An Act Declaring December 15 of Each Year as Naga City Charter Day and a Special Working Public Holiday in the City of Naga in Order to Commemorate the Anniversary of the Said City

text.en: In order to commemorate the charter anniversary of the City of Naga, December 15 of each year is hereby declared as Naga City Charter Day and a special working public holiday in the said city.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
